description.subject: Young woman with tanned skin and long dark wavy hair past the shoulders, seen from behind taking a mirror selfie, face in partial profile turned to her left, small gold hoop earring; image is a phone screenshot of a shopping app product gallery (back arrow, search and cart icons top, '7/15' counter, product card at the bottom reading 'R$49,00', 'Macaquinho Bia Curto Feminin...' with a 'Comprar Agora' button, store badge and 'Compartilhar' button)
description.pose: Standing with her back to the camera, weight on both legs, feet slightly apart, left arm relaxed at her side, right arm raised holding a black smartphone near her face, head turned slightly toward her left shoulder

clothing.top: Black romper bodice with thin spaghetti straps crossing in an X over the open back and black cord lacing in a criss-cross corset pattern down the back, tied in a bow at the waist with hanging cord ends
clothing.bottom: Short black flared romper skirt/shorts with two tiered ruffle layers, very short length
clothing.footwear: Black patent high-heel stiletto sandals with thin ankle straps
clothing.accessories: Small gold hoop earring, black smartphone, light manicured nails

description.setting: Clothing store fitting room seen in a tall mirror: grey floor-length curtain behind her, light grey walls, a small grey upholstered cube ottoman on the left, a wall hook with a black hanger, light wood-look floor, white mirror frame edge on the left
description.lighting: Soft warm indoor light from above and the front, even exposure, gentle shadows on legs and back, slight glow from the mirror's edge on the left
description.composition: Vertical full-body mirror selfie from head to feet, subject centered, back view, camera at chest height; the photo sits in the middle of a tall phone screenshot with black bars and app UI above and below
description.style: Photorealistic smartphone mirror selfie, fashion e-commerce / influencer product shot
description.colors: Black outfit and heels, tanned skin, dark brown hair, neutral greys of curtain and ottoman, beige-wood floor, off-white walls; orange-red app buttons and price in the UI
description.mood: Confident, flirty, stylish, casual night-out fashion
